about: Callout anchors for the 3D engine: points on the panel artboards where a callout line to a physical car part should leave the panel. Coordinates are Panel artboard pixels (600 x 780, origin top-left), body scroll at rest (0), measured by pixel scans of the settled render build/hv_final_p1_150.png (rive . --artboard="Panel 1" --viewport=600x780 --data=section=1 --advance=150). x,y = midpoint of the element edge facing the car; center/bbox given so the engine can pick another exit point. Generated UI: tools/gen_glass.py (hero_car); re-measure if that layout changes.
panel_note: world.as updatePanels: panel 0 sits on the right of the screen, panels 1-4 on the left, each turned ~41 deg toward the car. The Vehicle hero drawing is a plan view with the nose pointing right, so the car's left side is at the top of the drawing.
